title: APP.md frontmatter — app/v1 (agent app bundle + UI surface)
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter portion of an AIP-53 APP.md manifest — the on-disk form of an AppDefinition. Codifies shipped behaviour: `agents` may be empty for a UI-only app when `ui` is present (packages/app-kit/src/define-app.ts:49-52), and `data` / `category` are carried verbatim (packages/app-kit/src/types.ts).

schema.description: Exactly `app/v1`. Any other value MUST be refused by the loader.

id.description: Machine identifier for the app itself. Optional — an anonymous bundle cannot be installed by id. Written with any `@owner/` prefix as authored.

version.description: App version. Defaulted to `0.1.0` by defineApp when `id` is set and version is omitted (conformance rule 8).

description.description: App description. Also the APP.md markdown body.

path.description: Path to the AGENT.md, relative to the app dir.

agents.description: `{ id, path }` refs, one per bundled agent. MAY be empty ONLY when `ui` is present (UI-only app) — see the allOf guard below.

path.description: Path to the WORKFLOW.md, relative to the app dir.

workflows.description: `{ id, path }` refs, one per bundled workflow. Every bundled workflow MUST be referenced by at least one agent's workflows[] (attachment invariant, both directions).

workspace.description: Optional home workspace id (AIP-34). When set, a sibling WORKSPACE.md exists at the app dir root.

requires.description: What the app needs from its host. Either a flat array of APP ids this app depends on (legacy form), or an object { browser?, fs?, gpu?, secrets?, apps? }. Each `apps` entry is a bare id (dependency only) or an object { id, version?, workflows? }: `version` is a semver range (exact "1.2.3", caret "^1"/"^1.2"/"^1.2.3", or tilde "~1"/"~1.2"/"~1.2.3") the provider's installed version must satisfy; `workflows` lists which of the provider's `exposes.workflows` this consumer may call via the app_call tool — omitted/empty means the dependency carries no call permission.

fs.description: Needs the user's local filesystem beyond app data.

apps.description: Other app ids this app depends on — bare ids or { id, version?, workflows? } objects.

version.description: Optional semver range the provider's installed version must satisfy: exact ("1.2.3"), caret ("^1", "^1.2", "^1.2.3"), or tilde ("~1", "~1.2", "~1.2.3").

workflows.description: Provider workflows (ids from its exposes.workflows) this consumer may call via app_call. Omitted/empty = dependency only, no call permission.

agents.description: Agent ids this app exposes. Every id must name one of the app's own agents.

workflows.description: Workflow ids this app exposes — the callable surface other apps' requires.apps[].workflows entries may name (consumed via the app_call tool). Every id must name one of the app's own workflows.

exposes.description: A2A-visible agents/workflows. Ids must exist in the app's agents / workflows.

tools.description: The ui_tool_call / app_tool_call allowlist — every tool a UI-originated call may reach. Enforced server-side on every call.

port.description: Preferred local port hint for `app serve`.

ui.description: The UI surface. `html` (the full document) is required on the in-memory AppDefinition at defineApp time and is NOT carried in APP.md frontmatter — it is emitted to `ui.path`. Its non-emptiness is enforced by defineApp (conformance rule 5).

path.description: Emitted bundle path .agentproto/skill (must contain a SKILL.md).

artifacts.description: Artifact types this app's agents may produce, declared for discovery.

dev.description: Dev-launch configuration, carried verbatim in frontmatter.

dir.description: Default data-dir hint for the app_data_* plane, RELATIVE to the app dir (e.g. `data` means `<appDir>/data`). Overridden by an explicit dataDir at install time.

data.description: Default data-directory hint (AppDataDefinition). See AIP-53 § The app data plane.

externalReadRoots.description: Host directories the app is granted READ-ONLY access to outside its sandboxed dir (absolute or ~-relative). Carried verbatim in frontmatter by emit/load; validated to exist at install time. Read-only everywhere — there is no write/delete path for these roots.

category.description: Coarse grouping surfaced in host catalogs/trees (e.g. `book`). Freeform — not validated against a fixed enum.

allOf.title: UI-only carve-out
allOf.description: An app with an empty or absent `agents` array is conforming ONLY when `ui` is present (codifies packages/app-kit/src/define-app.ts:49-52 and the five builtin panels in packages/apps/src/index.ts that ship as agents: []).

allOf.title: Attachment invariant (structural part)
allOf.description: A UI-only app bundles zero workflows: a bundled workflow with no referencing agent would be an orphan (conformance rule 3).
